claim: GET /dashboard/summary/:id's notifications.recent leg reads only the caller's own notices, scoped as the bell scopes its list (NotificationsService.getNotifications): user_id = the token's userId (public.users.user_id, handed in through the handler's @CurrentUser()), restaurant_id = the house, newest created_at first, five. It read every notice in the house (select * by restaurant_id, no user_id), so a waiter's summary carried the owners' own-wage notice with both figures (ADR 0215 round 5 item 32), other members' notices and rows filed with no addressee. A row with a NULL user_id reaches no summary, as it reaches no bell; no user on the call reads no notices. Behaviour: apps/api-gateway/src/dashboard/dashboard.notices-are-the-callers.spec.ts (owner, manager and staff tokens built by the real JwtStrategy on one fixture, each checked against the bell's own list). fix/bell-reads-only-your-notices, money-policy M1 item 1. [changed 2026-10-08, PR #579 merging main: #579's DASH-W22 now refuses GET /dashboard/summary to any role that does not see amounts (staff, an unknown or a missing role) before anything is read. Owner and manager tokens are still checked against the bell's own list. The staff case asserts the refusal, no read, and the waiter's five from the bell. The no-user branch of the notices leg stays in the service but is no longer reached through the handler.]
